channel.title: Defy Group — AI agents for agencies
channel.description: Five AI agents that run marketing jobs end to end. Licensed to agencies, white-labelled, human sign-off on every gate.

item.title: Paid Media Agent — score the ad before you spend the budget
item.description: Reads a live Meta campaign, finds the category whitespace, generates a fresh funnel, scores every new ad for likely click-through before spend, and pushes the strongest back in — built paused, awaiting approval.

item.title: CRM Agent — know the winning email before you hit send
item.description: Designs three genuinely different email strategies, builds the approved one inside Klaviyo, calls the winner at 95% significance, and loops. Two human gates and a kill switch.

item.title: Influencer & GMV Agent — brief every creator on what lifts sales
item.description: Gives each TikTok Shop creator a distinct lane and returns a bespoke brief evidenced with their own posts. Delivered on a live L'Oréal programme.

item.title: Strategy Agent — a strategist's month of research, in a single run
item.description: Reads the competitive field and live audience conversation, finds the whitespace nobody owns, and renders a client-ready deck in the client's own brand.

item.title: Community Management Agent — a daily presence that runs itself
item.description: Finds the story, writes the post in the account's voice, generates the image and publishes. Runs Defy's own LinkedIn page; method accepted at SIGIR 2026.
